title: Exercise Concluded — FIDS and BHS Restoration

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The Flight Information Display Systems (FIDS) across Concourses A and B flicker and reset. All departure boards now show accurate flight times, gates, and statuses. The Baggage Handling System (BHS) confirms all bags are re-routed to correct sortation zones. The terminal is quieting as operations stabilize.
finalState: FIDS boards display correct flight data for all 214 departures.
BHS sortation logic is restored and functioning normally.
Passenger screening and re-entry procedures are underway per TIRP 4.3.
The AODB has been verified as clean and synchronized with the primary database.
All emergency systems are off and operational status is green.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: What was the most effective communication channel during the incident?
How could the verification process for restored data have been improved?
What was the impact of the delayed restoration on passenger trust and airport reputation?
How did the manual verification process affect coordination between IT, Ops, and Airline Liaisons?
What changes would you recommend to prevent a recurrence of unauthorized access to the AODB?
fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm all ICS 201 forms and evaluator sheets are collected before the hot wash begins.
